description: Source code for handling WRGG headers in MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and writing to flash memory.

methods.name: wrgg_fix_md5
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the MD5 checksum in a WRGG header within a memory device.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fixes the WRGG header in an MTD device at a specified offset, updating MD5 checksum and rewriting the block.
